summary: Ported Conduit (EF Core 10) to dual-provider operation: SQL Server and PostgreSQL selectable via the Data:Provider config switch with the existing Sqlite engine retained as a third value. Introduced a typed provider seam (enum + parser + IDatabaseProviderAccessor) resolved once at startup with fail-fast validation, named placeholder connection strings per engine in a new appsettings.json, and Npgsql.EntityFrameworkCore.PostgreSQL 10.0.3. Applied the B6 case-insensitivity parity fix (LOWER() on both sides) at all 22 Username/Email/Tag comparison sites across 12 feature files. No raw SQL, ADO.NET, migrations, or bulk paths exist, so the corresponding checklist areas are vacuously satisfied. Build and all 16 integration tests pass with zero warnings; live SQL Server/PostgreSQL smoke tests were not possible (no docker daemon) and are listed as unverified paths.
